mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 3-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight monetary policy stance amid strong labor market conditions, which typically precedes a stock market correction over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 2100 thousand units), consumer confidence and spending increase, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 2100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment below 134000 thousand over the prior 3 months signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS falls below 134000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises above its 6-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 109.0), manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential earnings pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 109.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO and GDPC1 both declining) fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
